purpose: Install and check an ordinary-player 0 A.D. MCP, then join only the user-provided match

target.tested_platform: Windows x64; Linux x64/WSL2 (installation, stdio and ENet only)

platform_selection_rule: Top-level install/check/mcp_server describe Windows. On Linux replace each whole object with platform_overrides.linux's corresponding object BEFORE executing anything. Do not run the Windows commands on Linux.

variables.BUNDLE: absolute extracted server directory on this machine
variables.PYTHON: absolute Python 3.11+ executable; architecture must match ENet
variables.GAME: absolute 0 A.D. 0.28.0 executable; binaries/system/pyrogenesis.exe on Windows or native pyrogenesis on Linux
variables.ENET: absolute enet.dll from the same Windows installation, or compatible Linux libenet.so.*
variables.PUBLIC_MOD: Linux public mod directory, public.zip or mod.json from the selected game installation
variables.USER_NICKNAME: distinct nickname assigned to this model, 1..32 characters, not all whitespace and without control characters

placeholder_rule: Expand these named placeholders in argument arrays; do not execute them as literal paths or interpolate untrusted shell strings. USER_UDP_PORT must become an integer in the actual MCP arguments, not a string.

check.manual_check: If native_files.game_version_verified is false, confirm 0.28.0 manually; never stop an existing host to read locked metadata.

mcp_server.lifetime: One persistent server and controlled game; stopping the server closes its owned game processes.

linux.instructions: Read LINUX.md. Prepare Python 3.11+ with venv/pip, 0 A.D. 0.28.0, ENet 1.3 and a working graphical desktop. No sudo or OS package installation is performed by the bundle.

check.manual_check: The display availability flag only checks environment variables. It does not prove graphics or gameplay works. PUBLIC_MOD affects this check, not the game data search path.

mcp_server.lifetime: One persistent server; stopping it closes its owned game processes.

connection_flow.if: not connected and user supplied host/port

connection_flow.until: ready=true after host assigns a seat and starts

nickname_rule: nickname and legacy player_name are optional aliases; omitting both uses MCP Player. If both are supplied they must match exactly. Validate 1..32 characters, not all whitespace and without control characters before launching a game. A nickname does not select a player seat.

multi_instance.topology: one model -> one persistent MCP process -> one controlled game client -> one host-assigned player seat
multi_instance.shared_room: Distinct instances may join the same host and game UDP port with different nicknames; internal relay ports are allocated separately.
automatic_isolation: Windows per-session temporary runtime and separate host/player ZIP files
multi_instance.windows_template: A shared template cache is protected during construction by an interprocess lock. New code does not launch that template directly; it copies it into the current session's private runtime.
multi_instance.operator_setup: Use distinct server processes; no manual instance ID or PYROGENESIS_MODS_DIR override is needed. Reusing an installation is allowed. Reusing one server connection still controls one player.
multi_instance.shutdown: Close only the current service's controlled processes and clean its own private runtime directories. Preserve other instances and user manual hosts.
limits: some GUI settings and crash filenames may remain shared
process/session isolation is not an OS security sandbox
gameplay acceptance depends on actual platform and match tests

gameplay_boundary: Dynamic observations and actions only through public MCP tools. Do not read hidden bridge files, saves or memory for gameplay.
terminal_result_guidance: Only outcome won or defeated is a confirmed player result. ready=false, disconnection, or outcome unknown alone does not mean defeat.
stop_conditions: user has not supplied match authorization/address
preserve: existing controlled game session unless user ends it
